label: Four arcs named, and Arc 15 exists
from: Arc 12 a roster · Arc 13 a roster · Arc 14 SIX adoptions and a title · no Arc 15 at all
to: ALL FOUR WITH BEATS, ARC 14 CORRECTED TO FOUR, AND ARC 15 OPENED
note:
ARC 12 — THE BRAT BLOOM, named for the adoption of a great many Chaos Agents. QUINN'S ADOPTION HAPPENS ON THE CAMPING TRIP. PEPPER, one of VIOLET'S TEAMMATES, learns that TOPPING CHAOS IS MORE FUN THAN TOPPING AN ANCHOR — and NATALIA STOPS BEING THE ICE QUEEN AND BECOMES THE CONSEQUENCE-ENGINEERING ICE PRINCESS, turns brat on purpose, and steals Pepper's compression shorts, WHICH ARE NOT DESIGNED FOR NATALIA'S ASS. Morrighan moves her tools out of the hole in the wall she had been tattooing from and opens her in-house parlour. AND SHE AND LIVI CREATE THE WELCOME HOME TRADITION.

ARC 13 — BANSHEE HAVEN RISES FROM THE GROUND, COMPLETING THE TRIFECTA OF AFFIRMED BODIES, and Bell hosts THE FIRST FULL-COMPOUND SEANCE.

ARC 14 — CORRECTED FROM SIX ADOPTIONS TO FOUR. Claudia, Hela, Remielle and Eirwen. ORIANNA AND FELICITY ARE NOT ADOPTED HERE. Destiny INTRODUCES Orianna — one of her coworkers — and the adoption is the arc after. Another camping trip.

ARC 15 — FISHNET STRUTS AND HAPPY TRAILS, and the Archive had no such arc an hour ago. ORIANNA (a gothic stripper) and FELICITY (her MAID WIFE) are adopted here, along with RIVEN (a bratty librarian) and HEATHER (Riven's gym-bunny slut wife) — two women who did not exist in this file at all. Dakota marries Mercedes. Another camping trip. AND BRYN BUILDS A POOL.

THE POOL IS ITS OWN RECORD AND IT DESERVES TO BE. See gh-pool.
